item.title: Gulls Drop Game Two of Series to Stars in Overtime
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell short to the Texas Stars in overtime tonight at H-E-B Center at Cedar Park, 6-5. Despite the loss, the Gulls still walk away tonight with a point. The team picked up three total of the series against Texas this weekend. Tonight saw a highly offensive game, with the Gulls and Stars staying close throughout the night. item.title: Gulls Wrap Road Trip with San Jose Matchup
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls are ready to go head-to-head with their cross-state rivals the San Jose Barracuda tonight at Tech CU Arena (7 p.m. PST; TV: AHLTV on FloHockey; Radio: Gulls Audio Network). Tonight marks the sixth game of the eight-game series San Diego and San Jose have scheduled this season. item.title: Gulls Late Rally Not Enough to Beat Barracuda
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the San Jose Barracuda tonight after a late rally was not enough to take over the lead at Tech CU Arena, 3-2. Tomas Suchanek took over in the crease early in the first period after Calle Clang made an early departure from the game. Suchanek faced 26 total shots, allowing only two through to keep San Diego in the game. The Barracuda found three goals before the Gulls were able to put some pressure on in the third period. item.title: Gulls Finish Short of IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the Rockford IceHogs tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 3-2. Tonight’s loss brings the Gulls to a 0-2-1-0 streak with a 24-18-8-4 record. item.title: Carpenter Shines in Gulls Victory Over IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls found their redemption and defeated the Rockford IceHogs tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 6-4. Tonight’s victory was essential for the Gulls. A three-game losing streak was broken and the team brings themselves to 62 points, which holds their sixth-position spot in the Pacific Division standings. item.title: San Diego Gulls Recall Drew Elliott From Tulsa
item.description: The San Diego Gulls announced today that the American Hockey League (AHL) club has recalled left wing Drew Elliott from the Tulsa Oilers (ECHL). Elliott, 22 (4/4/03), posted 14-14=28 points and 17 penalty minutes (PIM) in 37 games with Tulsa this season, leading the team in points and ranking second in goals.
